svg.aria-label: The same floor today: a builders' room with the AI team and the platform team, a system owner's room with operations, security and FinOps, joined by a thin line of paper; along the request queue four stations each show a limit, scripted automation that stops when a button moves, an agent that drops rules, an approval gate that repeats work after a pause and a guardrail fence with a gap, and a router sends easy tickets to a side door and hard ones to the slow planner, tested on questions, not actions
svg.title: The situation: five roles, four stations and their limits, a router tested on questions
